title: Circuit Symbol Reader
description: Five schematic symbols on flashcards, with a quiz that scores a full pass.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

educational.audience: Mentors preparing to read kit diagrams with students

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a schematic symbol, the learner identifies its component name and its role in a circuit.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Flip cards to reveal the name, or turn on Quiz me and pick the answer from a list
pedagogical.assessment: A full quiz pass scores 5 out of 5 with no flips.
